summary: Checked all 14 estimates against the supplied PDF after reading the complete 118429-character markdown conversion, including Appendices A-E. Read the cited PDF pages with pymupdf and inspected memory-only renderings of Figure 5 and the Figure 8 table. No numerical, scope, or coding discrepancies and no missing eligible outcomes or contrasts were found. The automated count-quote warnings are text-encoding failures: PDF p. 9, Figure 8, Total column visibly prints MANUAL (baseline) 62 (36, 10), DIRECT 72 (35, 12), STRUCTURED 88 (33, 10), and FREE-FORM 58 (34, 9). The numbers in parentheses are age summaries, as the caption states, and are not recorded as outcome statistics. The table text is encoded as control characters and page.find_tables() returns no tables. All extracted arm counts agree with the printed cells. The automated significance-quote warnings are page-layout failures. The sentence begins at the bottom of PDF p. 8, Section 5.2, and continues below the figures on PDF p. 9 with "among all the individual approaches (all p > 0.05)." Joining those text segments and normalizing whitespace reproduces the stored quote exactly for every estimate. The >0.05 bound supports both pooled LLM-ALL versus MANUAL outcomes; individual-pair p-values correctly remain null because no separate pair-specific result is printed. PDF p. 9, Section 5.2 explicitly prints 218 LLM-ALL participants; PDF p. 6, Section 4.2 prints 280 retained participants; PDF p. 8, Section 5 prints 280 selected frames and identifies the pooled Mann-Whitney U test. Figure 5 contains box plots without numerical outcome summaries. Unprinted means, dispersions, effect sizes, test statistics, and individual-pair totals appropriately remain null. The paper describes a randomized between-subjects study, expert ratings of selected frames produced during the assigned assistance condition, and one analyzed frame per retained participant. This supports the recorded question, constructs, measure, unit, direction, timing, AI availability, comparison types, within-person coding, and pooled participant se_basis. Expert-rating aggregation remains unspecified and is already noted in the extraction. The individual contrasts have no separately reported uncertainty and appropriately use not_reported. The two full-sample creativity outcomes and all recorded arm comparisons are covered. Self-reports, task duration, model-regeneration behavior, baseline knowledge, and expertise comparisons are correctly excluded. Appendix D confirms that the separate pilot recruited only 36 people, below the codebook minimum.
